Instructions: Tap the space bar in time with the beat. Three blocks of 40 beats, one per tempo (60, 90 and 120 bpm), in random order.

block.Description: Block number within the session (1 to 3)

beat.Description: Beat number within the block (1 to 40). Beats 1 to 5 are the synchronisation-in phase.

stim_onset_s.Description: Beat onset relative to block start

tap_onset_s.Description: Tap onset relative to block start; n/a if no tap

asynchrony_ms.Description: Tap minus beat time. Negative values mean the tap came before the beat; n/a if no tap
